description: Hand-curated 2022 monsoon-flood impact record for the 16 Risk Flag districts. impact_reference_date is the earliest date by which a source documents impact in the district within or just before the 15 Jun - 10 Sep window; it is an upper bound on onset, not the onset itself. Fields marked unknown could not be confirmed from a named source.

fields.evidence: strong (official notification or multiple independent reports) | moderate (one or two specific reports) | weak (single indirect report)
fields.impact_reference_date: ISO date, documented-by upper bound; null if unknown
fields.calamity_declared: ISO date of the provincial calamity-hit notification, 'unknown' if not confirmed for this district
fields.how_verified: fetched = page/PDF text read directly; search_excerpt = read from a search-engine excerpt of that page; cited_via_wikipedia = taken from a Wikipedia citation, source page not opened

districts.observed_hazard: monsoon rain flooding, then prolonged riverine/hill-torrent inundation
districts.notes: Named in the Sindh Relief Department notification of Sunday 21 Aug 2022, issued after rains that began Tue 16 Aug. District-specific onset date not pinned down; earlier July impacts in Sindh are reported only at province level. OCHA (4 Oct) expected Dadu to stay partially inundated until year end.

districts.notes: First listed GLOF: Eshperu Gol, Terich valley (Upper Chitral) 18 Jun; first in Lower Chitral (where the Risk Flag coordinate sits): Arkari 29 Jun; Reshun 8 Jul. Declared calamity-hit with D.I. Khan on 22 Aug.
